## Profile {#profile}

::: {.lead}
Epidemiologist and biostatistician specialising in biostatistics and epidemiology applied to international biomedical research (mother-child cohorts, exposome, regulated clinical trials and studies), with leading methodological experience on research projects involving human participants.

Currently Research Engineer at IDESP (INSERM – University of Montpellier) and lecturer at the Faculty of Medicine and Pharmacy of Montpellier.
:::

## Biomedical research — cohorts and regulated studies {#research}

### EXHES cohort (Exposure and Health Examination Survey)

::: {.meta}
[European HEALS project (FP7-ENV, European Commission)]{.org} [2017 to present]{.when}
:::

- Multicentre prospective mother-child cohort: 2,356 dyads, 10 European countries. Ethics approvals obtained in each country (in France: CPP Ouest IV–Nantes, no. 458/2017).
- Role: **first and corresponding author** of the reference publication describing the full cohort protocol (biobank, questionnaires, external/internal exposome) — *Methodology (lead)*, *Data curation (equal)*, *Formal analysis (equal)*, *Writing – original draft (lead)*.
- Design of the analysis plan, multi-country statistical analyses (meta-analysis of odds ratios and standardised mean differences), drafting and publication of the manuscript.
- Publication: Errahmani MY et al. The Exposure and Health Examination Survey mother-child(ren) cohort profile. *Exposome*, 2025. [10.1093/exposome/osaf009](https://doi.org/10.1093/exposome/osaf009){.doi}

### C-HEALTH study

::: {.meta}
[Montpellier University Hospital (CHU) / Institute of Evolutionary Science of Montpellier (ISEM)]{.org}
:::

- Research involving human participants (RIPH, French regulatory framework), national no. 2023-A02418-37, sponsored by Montpellier University Hospital. Biological follow-up protocol covering a complete menstrual cycle (daily saliva samples, connected device, blood self-sampling, ovulation tests).
- Role: **lead for the biostatistics component** — development of the statistical analysis plan (SAP) and conduct of the analyses.

### COBRA cohort

::: {.meta}
[French multicentre cohort]{.org}
:::

- Role: **data manager and lead for the statistical analyses** of the cohort.

### Good Clinical Practice certification (GCP / ICH-GCP)

- Certified in "ICH Good Clinical Practice E6(R3)" (current GCP standard) by The Global Health Network / Global Health Training Centre, score 95% (July 2026).

## Professional experience {#experience}

### Research Engineer — Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Metabolomics, Epigenetics

::: {.meta}
[IDESP (INSERM – University of Montpellier)]{.org} [Since January 2024 · Montpellier, France]{.when}
:::

Statistical and methodological analyses for cutting-edge research projects in environmental health and precision medicine.

- **Supervision & data curation:** processing and harmonisation of complex databases from national and international cohorts.
- **Advanced modelling:** development of statistical analysis plans (SAPs), implementation of models and analyses suited to the research questions, and development of R packages.
- **Scientific output:** methodological coordination for the writing of scientific reports, regulated calls for proposals and scientific articles.
- **Compliance & ethics:** 100% compliance maintained with GCP (ICH-GCP) standards and RIPH regulatory requirements across all studies managed.

### Adjunct Lecturer

::: {.meta}
[Faculty of Pharmacy / Faculty of Medicine, University of Montpellier]{.org} [Since September 2024 · Montpellier, France]{.when}
:::

Design and delivery of advanced academic modules in biostatistics, epidemiology, databases and SAS programming for health and pharmacy students.

- **Instructional design:** design and delivery of more than 100 hours of teaching in SAS programming, databases and applied statistics, from third-year undergraduate (L3) to second-year Master's (M2) level and for third-year pharmacy students.
- **Supervision & mentoring:** supervision and support of first- and second-year Master's students during their research internships.

### PhD Researcher

::: {.meta}
[Laboratory of Ionising Radiation Epidemiology (IRSN)]{.org} [October 2020 – September 2023 · Toulouse, France]{.when}
:::

- Thesis topic: Cardiac arrhythmias and conduction disorders after radiotherapy for breast cancer.
- Setting up epidemiological studies and writing protocols; literature searches.
- Handling of medical data and cohorts (SNDS, EGB, CAMBRIARYTHMO).
- Writing study-specific programs and statistical analysis plans; complex multidimensional analyses.
- Writing reports and scientific articles, and presenting results at national and international events.

### Biostatistics Intern

::: {.meta}
[IRSN – Epidemiology Laboratory]{.org} [March 2020 – August 2020 · Toulouse, France]{.when}
:::

- Topic: Cardiac arrhythmia after breast cancer treatment (radiotherapy) — exploratory study on EGB/SNDS health administrative data.
- Calculation of incidence rates and SIRs (Standardized Incidence Ratios); survival models (Kaplan-Meier, Cox regression).

### Biostatistics Intern

::: {.meta}
[Kwizda]{.org} [April 2019 – August 2019 · Vienna, Austria / Marly-le-Roi, France]{.when}
:::

- Topic: Preliminary analysis of methods for assessing the efficacy of biocidal products.
- Database construction, principal component and multiple correspondence analyses, modelling and interpretation of results.

## Skills and languages {#skills}
